#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int processChar(const string& s, int i, string& underScore, string& bracket) {
    if (s[i] == '(') {
        i++;
        while (s[i] != ')') {
            bracket += s[i];
            i++;
        }
        i++;
        bracket += '_';
        underScore += '_';
    } else {
        underScore += s[i];
        i++;
    }
    return i;
}

int maxRun(const string& str) {
    int maxLen = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < str.length(); i++) {
        if (str[i] == '_') {
            if (count > maxLen) {
                maxLen = count;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return maxLen;
}

int countNonEmpty(const string& str) {
    int count = 0;
    int words = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < str.length(); i++) {
        if (str[i] == '_') {
            if (count > 0) {
                words++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return words;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n;
    cin >> s;

    string underScore;
    string bracket;

    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        i = processChar(s, i, underScore, bracket);
    }

    underScore += '_';
    bracket += '_';

    int max1 = maxRun(underScore);
    int max2 = countNonEmpty(bracket);

    cout << max1 << " " << max2 << endl;
    return 0;
}
